functions.description: Parse Ivanti ICS syslog+JVM log header into timestamp, host, pid, thread, severity, class and message
Extract user and source IP for successful authentication events

conf.regex: /(?:Authentication failed for user '(?<user2>[^']*)' from (?<src_ip2>[0-9a-fA-F:.]+) reason=(?<reason>\S+) attempt=(?<attempt>\d+))|(?:Repeated authentication failures detected from (?<src_ip3>[0-9a-fA-F:.]+) attempts=(?<attempts>\d+) window=(?<window>\S+) user='(?<user3>[^']*)' possible_bruteforce=(?<possible_bruteforce>\w+))/

functions.description: Extract details for failed and repeated failed authentication events

functions.filter: message && (message.startsWith('VPN tunnel established') || message.startsWith('Blocked outbound') || message.startsWith('TLS handshake failed'))

conf.regex: /(?:VPN tunnel established for user '(?<vpn_user>[^']*)' from (?<vpn_src_ip>[0-9a-fA-F:.]+) vlan=(?<vlan>\d+))|(?:Blocked outbound connection attempt to blacklisted IP (?<blocked_dst_ip>[0-9a-fA-F:.]+) port=(?<dst_port>\d+) protocol=(?<protocol>\w+) user='(?<blocked_user>[^']*)')|(?:TLS handshake failed with client (?<tls_src_ip>[0-9a-fA-F:.]+) cipher=(?<cipher>\S+) reason=(?<tls_reason>\S+))/

add.name: user
add.value: user ? user : (user2 ? user2 : (user3 ? user3 : (vpn_user ? vpn_user : (blocked_user ? blocked_user : null))))

add.name: src_ip
add.value: src_ip ? src_ip : (src_ip2 ? src_ip2 : (src_ip3 ? src_ip3 : (vpn_src_ip ? vpn_src_ip : (tls_src_ip ? tls_src_ip : null))))

add.name: action
add.value: message.includes('authenticated successfully') ? 'login_success' : (message.startsWith('Authentication failed') ? 'login_failure' : (message.startsWith('Repeated authentication failures') ? 'login_failure' : (message.startsWith('VPN tunnel established') ? 'vpn_connect' : (message.startsWith('Blocked outbound') ? 'blocked' : (message.startsWith('TLS handshake failed') ? 'tls_failure' : (message.startsWith('Configuration change applied') ? 'config_change' : (message.startsWith('Session termination failed') ? 'session_error' : (message.startsWith('Concurrent session limit exceeded') ? 'session_limit' : 'other'))))))))

functions.description: Normalize user/src_ip fields across event types, classify action, derive protocol/timestamp, and clean up scratch fields

add.name: dest_ip
add.value: dest_ip || dst_ip || destination__ip || server__ip || dstaddr || dstip

add.name: dest_port
add.value: dest_port || dst_port || destination__port || dpt || dstport || dport

add.name: log_time
add.value: log_time || generated_time || receive_time || start_time || event__created || timestamp || event__start

functions.description: Alias Copilot/schematizer OCSF-style fields to canonical names

add.name: _time
add.value: (typeof log_time != 'undefined' && log_time) ? (/^\d{13}$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) : /^\d{10}$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) * 1000 : /^\d{13}\.\d+$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) : /^\d{10}\.\d+$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) * 1000 : new Date(String(log_time)).getTime()) / 1000 : _time

functions.description: Set _time from the parsed timestamp (log_time), if one was captured
Drop events shorter than 10 characters (empty/noise) (enable in Cribl UI to activate)
